usage: The word '傳送' is used as a verb to describe the action of sending something.
It can refer to sending messages, files, or even physical items.
It is commonly used in both formal and informal contexts.
When using '傳送', the object being sent usually follows the verb directly.
'傳送' is often seen in technological contexts but can be used in everyday situations as well.
